matchingsettings.title: Matching settings
matchingsettings.name: matching settings
matchingsettings.intro: Who may read and assign, the score weights (integers), the distance and load limits and how long an offer stays open.
matchingsettings.guide: The score combines distance, load and rating using the configured weights. Candidates beyond the distance limit or at the load limit are excluded. Ties use the shortest distance, then candidate ID. Stored positions expire after 900 seconds. The runtime considers up to 200 candidates and 100 batch requests. The exact solver handles up to 8 requests and 12 candidates.

predictionsettings.title: Prediction settings
predictionsettings.name: prediction settings
predictionsettings.intro: Who may read and record, the model id and unit shown on records and the prediction interval width in basis points.
predictionsettings.guide: The half-width is the absolute prediction multiplied by the configured basis points, divided by 10,000 and rounded down, with a minimum of 1. Model ID and unit are saved on new records. An actual can be recorded once. Predictions accept at most 50 features.

aigatewaysettings.title: AI gateway settings
aigatewaysettings.name: ai gateway settings
aigatewaysettings.intro: Route model calls by stage and configure budgets, retention and who may call or manage the gateway.
aigatewaysettings.guide: One US dollar is 1,000,000 micro-USD. The gateway reserves the estimated worst-case cost before a call and settles the actual cost afterward. A stage uses its fallback only if configured. The output estimates exclude input tokens.

aidocssettings.title: AI documents settings
aidocssettings.name: ai documents settings
aidocssettings.intro: Set document kinds and their fields, the gateway stage for extraction and who may upload, review and read.
aidocssettings.guide: Extraction uses the selected gateway stage. Low-confidence fields go to the review queue. Uploads can spend gateway budget and require gateway call access. The runtime accepts at most 380,000 characters even if the configured limit is higher.

knowledgesettings.title: Knowledge settings
knowledgesettings.name: knowledge settings
knowledgesettings.intro: Choose the answer stage, who may manage sources or ask questions, and the size of the library.
knowledgesettings.guide: Source visibility is applied per source. The source cap counts all sources in the tenant. Asking a question uses the selected gateway stage and requires gateway call access. Searches take up to 20 results and 500 query characters. Questions take up to 1,000 characters and use up to 10 results.

agentssettings.title: AI agents settings
agentssettings.name: ai agents settings
agentssettings.intro: Declare the action registry, the agents that use it, autonomy limits and who may run or approve.
agentssettings.guide: The lowest of the agent ceiling, action ceiling and requested run mode applies. High-risk actions always need human approval. Automatic entity creation writes real rows. Entity actions require a create permission and cannot write state, numbered or write-restricted fields. A required eval gates automatic runs.

evalssettings.title: AI evals settings
evalssettings.name: ai evals settings
evalssettings.intro: Eval suites and their cases (every case runs its agent in dry mode), the pass mark and who may run them.
evalssettings.guide: Every case runs in suggest mode, checks proposed actions and leaves generated-app data unchanged. The gateway calls still count against the AI budget. The score is the fraction of passing cases, rounded down to whole basis points. Each case needs an expectation. Agent approvers can also run evals.
